scenarios.name: conservative

lines.title: Quicksilver · Mageblood · 14% speed / 70% effect
lines.reason: Whole simulated objective fits capital, concentration, observed holding capacity and the combined risk budget. Probabilities or input costs include explicitly declared model assumptions; inspect the linked saved risk evidence.
lines.stopCondition: Stop if the signal leaves CRAFT, any used evidence expires, input prices change, or unsold inventory exceeds the observed capacity.

limitations: Advisory model, not executed trades or historical investment returns.
Per-option P95 budgets are not a portfolio P95. The displayed risk is a union bound for cash loss or bankroll overrun; no independence is assumed.
Sampling bounds simultaneously cover examined Monte Carlo cost/profit distributions at the displayed confidence, conditional on the declared model.
Own completed sales bound trial production capacity; asking supply and missing listings are not sales or demand.
Greedy selection is feasible and deterministic; it does not claim a globally optimal portfolio.

sensitivity.assumption: All crafting input spending increases by the stated percentage; proceeds and outcome probabilities are unchanged. This is a scenario, not a new market quote.
